ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white pixels (approx. 85%) contrasted against low-intensity black pixels (approx. 15%) primarily localized at the periphery and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central contiguous white region spanning both lobes. High-contrast black banding follows the entire trailing edge and distal tips. Minor low-intensity pixel clusters and streaks are distributed sporadically across the white field.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with a pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 10-15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Visible amplitude variations between 2-8 pixels, with more pronounced jaggedness near the distal tips compared to the notch area.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-convex trajectory on the leading edges with a complex sigmoidal sweep on the trailing edge, transitioning from concave near the notch to convex towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast dark pixels and irregular textures at both the left and right terminal tips, suggesting localized surface encrustations or scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, dark linear pixel streaks observed on the white ventral surface, most prominently on the right lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jaggedness and minor tissue loss visible along the trailing edge serrations; dark linear rake-like marks on the right interior fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent low-intensity circular spot located in the upper-mid region of the left lobe's white field.
